title: Fix Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff
brief: A Kubernetes pod is stuck in CrashLoopBackOff state and won't start. The broken pod manifest is at /tmp/broken-pod.yaml. Your task is to identify and fix the issues preventing the pod from running successfully.
hints: Look at the 'command' field - does that binary exist in the nginx container?
Check the environment variables - is there a reference to a non-existent secret?
Examine the livenessProbe - does the port match where nginx is actually listening?
Common fixes: remove invalid command, use 'value' instead of 'valueFrom' for env vars, match probe port to container port (80 for nginx)
Test your manifest with: kubectl apply --dry-run=client -f /tmp/broken-pod.yaml
